commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the Unbound seal/tower trail on my own account. A wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, so I came to the Archwardens fort. Why it matters I do not yet know. 2. Get into the fort keep and see its cellar, by the wall captain (Sakeeus-Wan) leave or unseen. 3. Talk to Sakeeus-Wan for leave, or find another way in unseen (the Guardroom door is marked; other doors are locked). 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar, nor who Theyne Indarys or Tsleel-Vaku are; I can ask them.

answer 1. The captain will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing carts on the western approach. I still seek the cellar the scout spoke of. 2. Kill the three raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan. 3. Do that, or take the trapdoor in the yard to get in unseen. 4. I do not know what the Sarpa raiders are like in strength, nor what the old prison below the keep holds; he says it is the order own.

answer 1. Raiders dead, I have the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster store, locked; Theyne Indarys holds that key. 2. Get into the quartermaster store and go down to the cellar, speak to gaoler Tsleel-Vaku. 3. Pick the store lock, lift Theynes key, or perhaps ask him. The captain warns that entering the store without leave is theft. 4. I do not know what the Jar of Hist Sap marked as Jal-Veesa Knot is for; I could look at it or ask.
pick Door to Quartermaster's Store win
